subject: Re: Kickoff: label-bias correction as a pipeline pre-processing stage
body:
Ximena,

Resourcing:

Staffing: Rosa 50% as tech lead, Farah 40% on the re-weighting implementation and its convergence behavior, Emeka 40% on the pipeline-stage API, Bilal 30% on benchmark harnessing. The method itself is cheap — it's the validation sweep that costs.

Compute: the fairness-benchmark reproduction runs on a handful of Titan A100s, nothing to plan around. The June validation sweep is different: re-training every supported model family with and without re-weighting, across the fairness notions, is a big fan-out. We hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 512 accelerators — for the week of 2026-06-22, which covers the full re-weighting sweep across all model families. I sized it with 30% headroom, so if the sweep grows we still fit inside the week.

One planning note: Q3 OKR lock is Jun 26, so the sweep results land just in time to ground whatever we commit for Q3. Tight but workable.

Deshawn
